manifest.name: @kenz1117/dsh-ui-rainbowspeak
manifest.description: RainbowSpeak (虹语) — rainbow marquee border for the DeepSeek Harness chat composer plus 小虹, a window-resident ba-ji-ball companion pet (five playable characters) driven by the host's authoritative turn boundaries.

scripts.bench:pet-visual: node tools/anim-bench/snapshot-pet.mjs --ref tools/anim-bench/.out/pet-reference && node tools/anim-bench/verify-pet-visual.mjs --ref tools/anim-bench/.out/pet-reference

bundle.text:
# dsh-ui-rainbowspeak bundle patch：dsh plugin add @kenz1117/dsh-ui-rainbowspeak
# 时以单条目插入 profile 根。行 id 指向本插件 node 半：
#   - 彩虹状态桥的宿主侧来源（会话座位与待交互座位）；
#   - 桌宠的只读边界服务 rainbowPet（只投影回合边界元数据），
#     并经 ./typert 子路径把契约贡献给 Typert 网关。
# 视觉效果由 client 半（lib/client.js）在浏览器注入样式表 + 挂载 shell.overlay 实现。
- insert:
    - id: ui-rainbowspeak
      name: '@kenz1117/dsh-ui-rainbowspeak'

readme.text: <div align="center">
虹语 RainbowSpeak — 一圈会流动的彩虹边框，外加一只住在窗口里的吧唧球桌宠「小虹」：五颗糖果球随你挑（红黄粉蓝绿），按参考图逐像素复刻，会看你的指针、等你点确认、只在该庆祝时庆祝。
[中文](README.md) · [English](README.en.md) ---

不接管任何插槽、不打宿主补丁、不注册工具、不注入系统提示。彩虹环是纯浏览器端装饰：一条 `conic-gradient` 圆环经蒙版只留卡片边缘，由**旋转图层**承载流动——渐变只画一次，之后交给合成器转，主线程不再为它每帧重绘。

桌宠也遵守同一条边界：宿主侧只多了一条**只读**的回合边界流（会话身份 + 回合序号 + 结束原因），**不携带任何聊天内容、历史或审批细节**；浏览器侧只往 `shell.overlay` 挂一个浮动条目，不改宿主的任何既有界面。

readme.section: 五颗球，五套形象，逐像素复刻
readme.text:
五颗球**不是**一个角色的五种配色——是五个独立角色：红红（傲娇冷面）、黄黄（慵懒半垂眼）、粉粉（憨萌大眼）、蓝蓝（理性眼镜）、绿绿（暴躁斗眼）。每个角色的脸都按参考图**逐像素实测复刻**（`tools/anim-bench/scan-faces-precise.mjs` 连通域 + 扫描线测量，部件误差 ≤0.5% 脸宽）：底色纯平涂、嘴形是扫描线生成的 clip-path 多边形、黄球「白眼球 + 红半圆盖」双层眼、蓝球镜框随体型缩放。球形几何有 `longhand + !important` 加固合同，宿主全局样式改不动它。

小虹的**成功与失败以宿主的回合边界为准**（经 Typert 远端读 `session/event` 的 `turn/end`）：被取消的一轮不会报喜，报喜是撒谎。远端不可用时它只依据客户端会话状态做「在跑 / 在等你」的表情，安静降级，不编造结论。

- **眼睛跟着指针走**：瞳孔朝指针方向滑（上限 = 球宽 5%，再按角色收敛——蓝球眼白小、增益最小，瞳珠永远滑不出眼白），目光是「滑」过去的不是「跳」过去的；指针静止久了还会随机扫视、缓缓回中；身体还会朝视线方向微微侧 1° 左右——像被自己的目光牵着；
- **戳一下**：挤压回弹带「果冻余振」（衰减尾摆，各级面积分≈1、体积守恒），冒台词 + 从头顶飘出两三颗糖果心；
- **连戳（双击）**：原地转一个圈，转完晕一小会儿（×_× 眼）；
- **按住不动**：是摸摸——果冻鼓起、眯眼笑、腮红浮现；
- **打盹时戳它**：惊醒——弹起来抖一抖，睡意全无；
- **拖着走**：顺着惯性歪，像被吊在指尖，整只轻微「捏起」；松手还有一记落地小弹跳；
- **闲得久了**：自己哼支小曲，♪ 音符飘出来（36–60 秒随机冷却）；
- **每次登场**：随机挑一个入场动画——弹现 / 空降（影子先落地等你）/ 旋转 / 蹦入；
- **点右键**（或键盘 `Shift+F10`）：小菜单——角色 / 关注范围 / 大小 / 让它躲一会儿；
- **它感知环境**：窗口被拖大拖小会踉跄一下找平衡，睡醒先伸个懒腰，有人滚聊天记录时目光会跟着内容走一点——住在窗口里，不是贴在窗口上；
- **动画强度三档**：全量 / 轻柔 / 关——轻柔档保留全部反应但收敛幅度，关档只留表情切换（系统级「减弱动态效果」始终优先）。
彩虹环实时反映会话：agent 运行中加速（4 s → 1.2 s/圈）；工具审批或向用户提问待处理时转琥珀色慢脉冲；发送失败或 agent 出错转红色快脉冲；一轮完成播放一周期的庆祝闪光。不用盯屏幕，余光就知道它干活到哪一步。

readme.section: 七种配色，还能跟着主题走
readme.text: 经典彩虹 / 极光 / 日落 / 蜜桃 / 海洋 / 赛博霓虹之外，还有**跟随主题**——经 `color-mix` 从宿主品牌色派生，深浅主题切换即时跟随，永不出戏。

| 角色 | 眼 | 嘴 | 待机动作 | 气质 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **红红** | 圆白眼 + 绿瞳 | 实心左尖三角 + 横杠 | 短促点头 | 傲娇、冷面 |
| **黄黄** | 白眼球 + 红半圆盖（半垂眼） | 白色笑口 + 嘴角黑豆 | 慢悠悠钟摆 | 慵懒、装酷 |
| **粉粉** | 大竖椭圆白眼 + 蓝瞳（对眼） | 波浪笔画 | 弹跳（squash & stretch） | 憨、呆萌 |
| **蓝蓝** | 黄框眼镜（随体型缩放）+ 黑瞳 | 粗 V 形 | 匀速呼吸 | 理性、认真 |
| **绿绿** | 斗在一起的小白眼 + 橙瞳（探出眼白） | 左低右高折线 | 不耐烦轻颤 | 暴躁、别扭 |

六种状态（待机 / 干活 / 等你 / 庆祝 / 出错 / 打盹）在五个角色上各有专属演绎：黄球干活时红盖压得更低、等你时瞳珠从盖下探出；蓝球打盹时镜框保持原形、镜片里是闭眼线；眨眼也不压镜框。切换走 `scale` / `translate` 渐变过渡——表情是「变」过去的，不是瞬切。

- **彩虹跑马灯边框**：输入框卡片四周流动彩带，由旋转图层驱动——渐变只画一次再交给合成器转，**每帧重绘次数实测 360 → 0**。
- **桌面宠物「小虹」**：落在 `shell.overlay` 浮动层，可拖拽、位置持久化；纯 CSS 几何临摹的吧唧球简笔风，**无任何外部素材**，没有第三方形象的授权问题。
- **五个可选角色**（右键菜单或设置面板切换）：球色是身份、表情随状态变化，五套基准脸 + 25 组专属关键帧（待机/干活/庆祝/出错/打盹 × 五角色），动作语言互不相同。
- **互动细节**：戳一下果冻余振回弹、头顶飘糖果心（2-3 颗、连戳自动节流）、拖拽惯性摆动、瞳孔随指针滑动 + 随机扫视 + 视线倾斜。
- **权威回合边界**：宿主半经 Typert 贡献一条只读事件流（`remote.rainbowPet/watch`），浏览器半逐帧用同一份 Zod schema 校验后再采信；断号即重连，绝不拿半截状态糊弄用户。
- **宿主样式加固**：桌宠的圆形（球体/眼睛/瞳珠/命中区/光晕）全部 `longhand + !important` 钉死——宿主的全局 `button span` 规则改不动它；镜框线宽用容器查询单位随体型缩放，旧引擎自动回退固定线宽。
- **设置面板**（`Settings` → `Rainbow border`）：启用/禁用、流速、环宽、配色、位置、反向流动、呼吸亮度；**桌面宠物**分组：启用、角色（五选一）、关注范围、动画强度（全量/轻柔/关）、大小（0.6–1.6×）。全部偏好持久化在 `localStorage`，即时生效。

- **在真实宿主条件下的样子**（模拟宿主全局规则渲染——见 [`preview/pet-client-sim.html`](preview/pet-client-sim.html)）：

- **七种配色**：经典彩虹、极光、日落、蜜桃、海洋、赛博霓虹，以及**跟随主题**（`color-mix` 派生自宿主品牌令牌）。

| 赛博霓虹 | 极光 | 日落 |
  | --- | --- | --- |
  |  |  |  |

- **跟随主题**（浅色模式）：边框取自宿主品牌色，主题切换即时跟随。

- **会话状态感知**：agent 运行中环加速；审批/ask-user 待处理琥珀色慢脉冲；出错红色快脉冲；一轮完成播放庆祝闪光。优先级：错误 > 提醒 > 运行。
- **聚焦增亮**：输入框聚焦时环增亮增饱和，失焦缓退。
- **无障碍**：遵循 `prefers-reduced-motion`（动画禁用、保留静态环与表情）；设置控件带本地化标签与 aria 属性。
- **中英双语**：文案经宿主 locale 注册表下发，跟随宿主语言设置。

- 插件在 apply 时挂载单张 `<style data-plugin>` 样式表，dispose 时移除（effect 生命周期）。
- 输入框卡片的 `::before` 绘制 `conic-gradient`，`mask` 合成只留边缘环带；色彩层是一张正方形锥形渐变绕中心自转 360°——不需要 `@property` 注册插值角度。
- 用户偏好与会话状态投影到 `<html>` 的 `data-rainbow-*` 属性与内联 CSS 变量，每个开关即时生效、无需重建样式表。
- 桌宠**宿主半**提供只读服务 `rainbowPet`：监听 `turn/start` / `turn/end`，只投影边界元数据；**浏览器半**经 `ctx.remote.$mount()` 消费，逐帧 Zod 校验、帧号连续性检查、断号退避重连。
- 桌宠形象全部是纯 CSS 几何（无图片/无 canvas）：嘴形是参考图扫描线生成的 `clip-path` 多边形，动画只走 `scale` / `translate` / `rotate` 合成属性，**每帧重绘为 0**；换状态不触发重排。
- 形象对宿主样式与尺寸变化做了完整加固：圆形用 longhand + `!important` 钉死、镜框线宽用 `cqw` 随体型缩放（旧引擎回退 px）、视线跟随按球宽比例并按角色收敛。

```sh
pnpm install        # 依赖（peer 经 scripts/link-peers.mjs 链入 monorepo checkout）
pnpm test           # vitest 套件（node 半边、偏好钳制、状态投影、桌宠状态机与互动数学、bundle 冒烟）
pnpm typecheck      # tsc --noEmit
pnpm bundle         # tsdown: lib/index.js + lib/remote.js + lib/typert.host.js（node 半边）+ lib/client.js（浏览器 IIFE）

形象复刻工具链（`tools/anim-bench/`）：`scan-faces-precise.mjs` 参考图逐像素精测（连通域 + 扫描线）、`scan-runs.mjs` 定向切面全段色段、`mouth-poly.mjs` 扫描线 → `clip-path` 多边形、`compare-faces.mjs`「参考 | 实现 | 差分」三联图、`measure-grid.mjs` 大刻度读数图、`measure-implementation.mjs` 双口径 DOM 复测。形象规格与实测结论见 [`docs/character-design.md`](docs/character-design.md)。

- **宿主**：dsh 桌面/网页宿主，实测基准 **0.2.x**（`engines.dsh >= 0.1.2-alpha.1` 为下限）。Peer：`@deepseek-ai/cordis`（宿主运行时提供）。
- **引擎**：Chromium/Chrome **≥ 105** 体验完整（容器查询单位 `cqw`、`@property` 变量眨眼）。旧引擎自动降级：镜框退回固定 2.1px 线宽、眨眼退回整体压合——表情与配色不受影响。
- **桌宠远端**：需要宿主支持 Typert 与客户端 Remote 运行时；缺失时插件照常加载，桌宠降级为「只看客户端会话状态」。
- **无障碍**：`prefers-reduced-motion` 全档尊重。

<div align="center">

RainbowSpeak (虹语) — a flowing rainbow border for the chat composer, plus Prism (小虹), a ba-ji-ball companion that lives in the window: five candy balls to pick from (red / yellow / pink / blue / green), replicated pixel-by-pixel from the reference art, watching your pointer, waiting when you must confirm, and only celebrating when a turn really finished.
[中文](README.md) · [English](README.en.md) ---

No slots taken over, no host patches, no tools registered, no system prompts injected. The rainbow ring is pure browser-side decoration: a `conic-gradient` circle masked down to the card edge, carried by a **rotating layer** — the gradient paints once, then the compositor spins it; the main thread never repaints per frame.

The pet obeys the same boundary: the host side adds only a **read-only** turn-boundary stream (session id + turn index + end reason), carrying **no chat content, history, or approval details**; the browser side mounts one floating entry on `shell.overlay` and touches nothing else in the host UI.

readme.section: Five balls, five characters, replicated pixel-by-pixel
readme.text: The five balls are **not** one character in five colors — they are five independent characters: Hong-Hong (tsundere, cool), Huang-Huang (lazy, half-lidded), Fen-Fen (derpy, big-eyed), Lan-Lan (rational, bespectacled), Lyu-Lyv (grumpy, cross-eyed). Every face is **measured and replicated pixel-by-pixel** from the reference art (`tools/anim-bench/scan-faces-precise.mjs`, connected components + scanlines, part accuracy ≤0.5% of face width): flat-filled bodies, mouths as scanline-derived `clip-path` polygons, Huang-Huang's two-layer "white eyeball + red lid", Lan-Lan's frames scaling with body size. Every circle carries a `longhand + !important` hardening contract — host-wide global styles cannot reshape them.

readme.section: Five balls, five characters, replicated pixel-by-pixel
readme.text: Success and failure follow the host's **authoritative turn boundary** (via the Typert remote reading `session/event` `turn/end`): a cancelled turn never gets celebrated — celebrating a cancel would be lying. Without the remote runtime the pet quietly degrades to client-session-only moods, never inventing conclusions.

readme.section: The border is the session state
readme.text: The ring reflects the conversation in real time: faster while the agent runs (4 s → 1.2 s/turn); amber slow-pulse while a tool approval or question awaits you; red fast-pulse on failures; a one-cycle celebratory flash when a turn completes. Peripheral vision is enough to know where things stand.
Classic rainbow / aurora / sunset / peach / ocean / cyberpunk — plus **follow-theme**, derived from the host brand color via `color-mix`, following light/dark switches instantly.

| Character | Eyes | Mouth | Idle motion | Temper |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Hong-Hong** (red) | Round white eyes, green iris | Solid left-pointing wedge + bar | Sharp nods | Tsundere, cool |
| **Huang-Huang** (yellow) | White eyeball + red half-lid | White grin + mouth-corner bean | Lazy pendulum | Lazy, aloof |
| **Fen-Fen** (pink) | Big vertical whites, blue iris (cross-eyed) | Wavy stroke | Bounce (squash & stretch) | Derpy, sweet |
| **Lan-Lan** (blue) | Yellow square frames (size-scaled), dark pupils | Thick V | Metronome breathing | Rational, earnest |
| **Lyu-Lyv** (green) | Jammed-together small whites, orange iris (overhanging) | Low-left-to-high-right zigzag | Impatient twitch | Grumpy |

Six states (resting / working / waiting / celebrating / error / sleeping) get a character-specific take on each ball: Huang-Huang's lid presses lower while working and the pupil peeks out while waiting; Lan-Lan's frames keep their shape while sleeping and while blinking. State switches tween via `scale` / `translate` — expressions *become*, they don't snap.

- **Rainbow marquee border**: flowing ribbon around the composer card, driven by a rotating layer — **measured repaints per frame: 360 → 0**.
- **Desktop pet "Prism"**: lives on `shell.overlay`, draggable with persisted position; pure CSS geometry, **zero external assets**, therefore no third-party-character licensing concerns.
- **Five selectable characters** (context menu or settings): ball color is identity, expressions change with state — five base faces + 25 dedicated keyframe sets (five states × five characters), each with its own motion language.
- **Interaction details**: jelly-afterquiver poke rebound, candy hearts from above the head (2–3, auto-throttled when spam-poked), inertial drag sway, pointer-following pupils + random saccades + gaze lean.
- **Authoritative turn boundary**: the host half contributes a read-only event stream (`remote.rainbowPet/watch`); the browser half validates every frame with the same Zod schema, requires contiguous sequence numbers, and backs off on gaps.
- **Host-style hardening**: every circle (body / eyes / pupils / hit area / aura) is pinned with longhand radii + `!important` — host-wide `button span` rules cannot deform them; frame stroke

- **Under simulated host conditions** (host-like global rules applied — see [`preview/pet-client-sim.html`](preview/pet-client-sim.html)):

- **Seven palettes**: classic rainbow, aurora, sunset, peach, ocean, cyberpunk, and **follow-theme** (`color-mix` from host brand tokens).

| Cyberpunk | Aurora | Sunset |
  | --- | --- | --- |
  |  |  |  |

- **Follow-theme** (light mode): the border takes the host brand color and follows theme switches instantly.

- **Session awareness**: the ring speeds up while running; amber slow-pulse while waiting for approvals/questions; red fast-pulse on errors; a celebratory flash on turn completion. Priority: error > attention > running.
- **Focus glow**: the ring brightens while the composer is focused, easing back on blur.
- **Accessibility**: honors `prefers-reduced-motion` (animations disabled, static ring and expressions kept); localized labels and aria attributes on all controls.
- **Bilingual**: copy is served through the host locale registry and follows the host language.

Then run `pnpm install` in the profile directory and restart the host. With the `link:` form, running `pnpm bundle` in the plugin repo is enough — the host picks up changes on its next restart, no reinstall needed.

- The plugin mounts a single `<style data-plugin>` stylesheet on apply and removes it on dispose (effect lifecycle).
- The composer card's `::before` paints the `conic-gradient`; `mask` compositing keeps only the edge ring; the color layer is a square conic gradient rotating 360° around the card center — no `@property` angle interpolation needed.
- Preferences and session state project onto `<html>` `data-rainbow-*` attributes and inline CSS variables — every switch is immediate, no stylesheet rebuild.
- The pet's **host half** provides a read-only `rainbowPet` service listening to `turn/start` / `turn/end`, projecting boundary metadata only; the **browser half** consumes it via `ctx.remote.$mount()`, validating every frame with the same Zod schema, checking sequence continuity, and backing off on gaps.
- The pet itself is pure CSS geometry (no images, no canvas): mouths are `clip-path` polygons derived from reference-art scanlines; animation uses only `scale` / `translate` / `rotate` compositing-friendly properties — **zero repaints per frame**; state switches never trigger layout.
- The look is fully hardened against host styles and size changes: circles pinned with longhand + `!

```sh
pnpm install        # deps (peers linked via scripts/link-peers.mjs for monorepo checkouts)
pnpm test           # vitest suite (node half, pref clamping, state projection, pet state machine, bundle smoke)
pnpm typecheck      # tsc --noEmit
pnpm bundle         # tsdown: lib/index.js + lib/remote.js + lib/typert.host.js (node half) + lib/client.js (browser IIFE)

The replica toolchain (`tools/anim-bench/`): `scan-faces-precise.mjs` pixel-precise reference measurement (connected components + scanlines), `scan-runs.mjs` targeted full-run color segments, `mouth-poly.mjs` scanlines → `clip-path` polygons, `compare-faces.mjs` reference-vs-impl-vs-diff triptychs, `measure-grid.mjs` gridded reading sheets, `measure-implementation.mjs` dual-caliber DOM re-measurement. Specs and findings live in [`docs/character-design.md`](docs/character-design.md).

- **Host**: dsh desktop/web hosts; tested against **0.2.x** (`engines.dsh >= 0.1.2-alpha.1` is the floor). Peer: `@deepseek-ai/cordis` (provided by the host runtime).
- **Engine**: Chromium/Chrome **≥ 105** for the full experience (container-query units, `@property`-driven blinking). Older engines degrade gracefully: frame stroke falls back to a fixed 2.1px, blinking falls back to whole-eye squashing — expressions and palettes are unaffected.
- **Pet remote**: needs Typert + client Remote runtime support; without them the plugin still loads and the pet degrades to client-session-only moods.
- **Accessibility**: `prefers-reduced-motion` honored at all tiers.
